text: わしは　あの　ニュースが　みたくて　カラーテレビを　かったんじゃ！

structure.jp: あの　ニュースが　みたくて
structure.en: wanted to see that news, so

structure.jp: カラーテレビを　かったんじゃ！
structure.en: I bought a color TV, you see!

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says you want to do it. Here it is in its て shape, which adds 'and so'. みたくて = 'wanted to watch, so'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: みたくて　カラーテレビを　かったんじゃ
patterns.explanation: The て shape joins two parts, and here the first part is the reason for the second. みたくて　カラーテレビを　かったんじゃ = 'I wanted to watch it, so I bought a color TV'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a verb gives the feeling of explaining something. じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. かったんじゃ = 'I bought it, you see'.
